changelog:
• Camera Stream Parser Fix: Fixed corrupted MJPEG chunk slicing bug and split EOI frame boundary detection, ensuring 100% clean JPEG decoding without frame drops
• Network Unblocking: Removed Wi-Fi callback pause lock so stream connects reliably across hotspots and APs
• Safe Bitmap Recycling: Invalidate corrupted inBitmap handles automatically to prevent decode deadlocks
• Smart IP Fallback: Auto-rotates between configured IP, 192.168.4.1 (Neuronova SoftAP), and esp32cam.local (mDNS)
• Draw Line Speed: Default speed set to 50 for smooth trajectory execution
